meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据屏幕操作自动生成新技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常做重复研究操作，想自动生成技能来提速。
copy.tagline_en: Auto-generate skills from your screen activity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat research steps and want skills to automate them.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过 screenpipe 观察你的屏幕操作，发现重复的研究工作流程，并与已有技能对比。对于未被覆盖的模式，它会草拟新技能或组合现有技能的方案。
howto.when: 当你要求分析最近的工作并提出新技能时触发，例如说“分析我过去4小时的工作并建议新技能”。需要本地运行 screenpipe 守护进程（端口3030）。

say.text: 分析我过去一天的工作，看看有什么新技能可以创建。
检查我最近的工作流程，找出未被现有技能覆盖的部分。
say.note: Claude 会匹配已有技能，并建议组合或新技能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude observes your screen via screenpipe, detects repeated research workflows, compares them with existing skills, and drafts new skills or composition recipes for uncovered patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze recent work and propose skills, e.g., "Analyze my last 4 hours and propose new skills." Requires local screenpipe daemon on port 3030.

say_en.text: Analyze my last day of work and suggest new skills to create.
say_en.note: Claude queries screenpipe, clusters patterns, and generates skill proposals.

say_en.text: Check my recent workflows and find what's not covered by existing skills.
say_en.note: Claude matches against existing skills and suggests compositions or new skills.
